tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Returns the profile of Shenzhen Far East Oil Drilling Engineering Ltd. (FEODE): legal name, year of establishment, summary of activities, headquarters, production base, contact details and the seven lines of business. Use it to identify the Company or to obtain its contact details.

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Lists the seven lines of business with identifier, name, summary, key figure and page address. Use it first to obtain the identifiers accepted by get_product_specs, get_track_record and get_enquiry_guide.

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: get_product_specs
tools.description: Returns one line of business: name, summary, key figures with the object and date they refer to, description, page address, plain-text address and the sections of its page. Identifiers: subsea-wellhead, drill-pipe, ccs, completion, fishing, well-abandonment, supervision (feccs is accepted for ccs). The text of a section is obtained with fetch.

id.description: Identifier of the line of business: subsea-wellhead, drill-pipe, ccs, completion, fishing, well-abandonment, supervision

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: get_certifications
tools.description: Lists the qualifications of the Company by group: API Spec Q1 registration and API Monogram licences, classification of the subsea wellhead system by Bureau Veritas and China Classification Society, management system certificates, awards and recognition. Each entry names the certificate and its subject; the scope of each licence is as stated on the certificate.

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: search_capabilities
tools.description: Keyword search across the seven lines of business (names, summaries, descriptions and key figures), for example "subsea wellhead 15,000 psi", "single-trip abandonment" or "continuous circulation". Returns the matching lines, most relevant first. For the full text of all pages, use search.

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Returns selected operations published on the website, for all lines of business or for one (subsea-wellhead, drill-pipe, ccs, completion, fishing, well-abandonment, supervision): year, title, description, key figure and page address. Figures refer to the operation and year stated in each entry.

line.description: Optional: identifier of one line of business

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Lists the brochures and catalogues available for download (PDF), with title, file size, address and the line of business they belong to.

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Returns the frequently asked questions and their answers as published on the website, optionally only those matching keywords.

query.description: Optional keywords, in English or Chinese

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: get_enquiry_guide
tools.description: Describes how to make an enquiry, for one line of business or for all: the information to provide, the subject line, the page and the contact details. Enquiries are submitted with submit_enquiry; machining enquiries are covered by get_machining_terms and submit_machining_rfq.

line.description: Optional: identifier of one line of business

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search of all pages of the website, in English or Chinese; the language follows the query unless lang is given. Returns the most relevant pages and sections (ten by default), each with an identifier for fetch, a title, the page address and an excerpt. Use it to locate information before citing it.

query.description: Search terms, in English or Chinese

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns the full text of a page, or of one section of a page, by the identifier given by search, for example ccs or ccs#specifications (identifiers of Chinese results start with zh:). Page addresses are accepted as well.

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: list_drill_pipe
tools.description: Lists the items of the drill-string reference (NOV Grant Prideco drill pipe, heavy-weight drill pipe and drill collars) with identifier, label, product type, connection, grade and units. Values are transcribed from the manufacturer's performance sheets and are given for reference only.

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: get_drill_pipe_specs
tools.description: Returns the performance data of one drill-string item: pipe body (new and premium torsional and tensile yield, internal pressure, collapse), tool joint (outside and inside diameter, make-up torque, drift, torsional yield) and assembly values. Identifiers are given by list_drill_pipe, for example dp-5-19.50-s135-nc50.

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: search_drill_pipe
tools.description: Keyword search of the drill-string reference, for example "NC50", "5 S-135", "HT55", "8 drill collar" or "XT57". Every term must match. Returns the matching items with all their data.

query.description: Size, grade, connection or product type

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: get_drill_string_guidance
tools.description: Returns the NOV Grant Prideco operating guidance on one topic, or on all topics when none is given: make-up torque practice, handling and grip distance, care and handling, double-shoulder and premium connections, sour service, field usage, pipe grades, heavy-weight drill pipe, drill collars, connection interchange, kelly, crossover subs, well-control formulae, unit conversion, and reference_tables (images of the manual's dense tables: for exact values, give the image address rather than retyping the numbers).

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: get_machining_services
tools.description: Returns the machining and testing capabilities of the Huizhou base: machining envelope, processes, equipment, testing, handling, materials, industries served and third-party references. Work is carried out to the client's drawing or specification; terms are given by get_machining_terms.

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: get_machining_terms
tools.description: Returns the terms for machining enquiries: order process, prepayment and payment method (bank wire transfer, T/T), compliance requirements, prohibited items, intellectual property and liability, and the required and optional fields of a request for quotation.

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).

tools.name: submit_machining_rfq
tools.description: Submits a request for quotation for machining or testing to the client's drawing or specification. The request passes an automated prohibited-use and sanctions screening; if cleared, it is registered for follow-up by an engineer from enquiry@feode.com. The legal entity, its country, a named contact person and the end-use are required. The result is an acknowledgement, not an offer or quotation; no payment is taken.

country.description: Country of registration of the legal entity

email.description: E-mail address of the contact person (company domain)

part_description.description: Description of the part or component, or drawing reference

drawing_url.description: Address of a drawing or specification (optional)

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Submits an enquiry for one of the seven lines of business, or a general enquiry. Required: line, company, country, name of the contact person, company e-mail address and a summary of the requirement. The enquiry is checked and screened for prohibited uses and sanctioned regions; enquiries within scope are followed up by an engineer. The result is an acknowledgement, not an offer or quotation.

line.description: Line of business concerned, or general

email.description: Company e-mail address of the contact person

scope.description: Optional: scope of supply or services

lang.description: Language of the result: en (English, the default) or zh (Chinese).
